anomalies.observed: In the 'Capacitive Touch Button (TSC)' block on the root sheet (PCB.kicad_sch), the two global labels NET0005 and NET0012 are joined onto the same node, and that node is also tied to the left terminal of R4 (1k, the series resistor to the BTN electrode) and to the non-grounded terminal of C7 (22n). On the MCU, NET0005 is PB5 (pin 57, TSC_G2_IO2) and NET0012 is PB7 (pin 59, TSC_G2_IO4). Thus the electrode drive line and the sampling-capacitor line are shorted together.
anomalies.expected: The specification states these are two separate nets: 'TSC_G2_IO2: U2 pin 57 (PB5) — R8 (1 kΩ series resistor) — A2 pin BTN' and 'TSC_G2_IO4: U2 pin 59 (PB7) — C14 (22 nF to GND) — this is the TSC sampling capacitor for the group'. PB7 should connect only to the sampling capacitor to GND, and PB5 should connect only through the series resistor to the electrode; the two TSC channels must not share a net.

evidence.quote: Root sheet, 'Capacitive Touch Button (TSC)' block: labels NET0012 and NET0005 both terminate on the wire that feeds R4 (1k) left terminal and C7 (22n); A3.BTN via R4, A3.SHLD to GND.
Root sheet MCU U1: pin 57 PB5 -> NET0005, pin 59 PB7 -> NET0012.
TSC_G2_IO2: U2 pin 57 (PB5) — R8 (1 kΩ series resistor) — A2 pin BTN ... TSC_G2_IO4: U2 pin 59 (PB7) — C14 (22 nF to GND) — this is the TSC sampling capacitor for the group.

anomalies.impact: The STM32 Touch Sensing Controller's two Group-2 channels are merged and the sampling capacitor is placed across the electrode drive path instead of on its own channel. The capacitive touch button will fail to sense correctly (or at all), and the two TSC pins are driven against each other.
